## Problem

The `rebar-implement` skill (examples/agent-skills/rebar-implement/SKILL.md) carries a "Model
tiering" section that pins the implementer subagent to strong/standard/cheap model tiers to save
tokens. This model-level gradient adds complexity (a tier table, per-dispatch tier-naming rules,
a dedicated 4e-bis "Tier escalation" ladder, per-leaf tiering session-log requirements) for
savings that only materialize on wide epics. We are removing it.

Separately, Phase 0's preflight hard-stops on any ticket with no children. That is too strict: a
`story`/`task` with no children but a recorded file impact is already an executable code leaf —
the file impact is exactly the acceptance the completion-verifier close gate needs. The skill
should execute such a ticket as a single leaf instead of refusing it.

## Plan

1. Remove the model-level gradient: delete the "## Model tiering" section; strip tiering language
   from Phase 3 (non-code leaf), 4a, and 4d while PRESERVING the held-out discipline (the
   implementer stays a separate subagent, which never depended on tiering); rewrite 4e-bis from
   "Tier escalation" to a tier-free "Escalation — when re-dispatch isn't enough"; reground the
   Phase 5 residual-sweep example.
2. Allow a childless story/task with a recorded file impact to run as a single leaf: Phase 0
   recognizes two executable shapes (has children -> tree; childless story/task with non-empty
   `rebar get-file-impact` -> single leaf) and stops only when neither holds; add a Phase 2
   callout collapsing Phases 3/5/6 to one change; update the frontmatter description, Phase 0
   heading, and Reporting stop line.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] No "Model tiering" section and no strong/standard/cheap model-tier references remain in
      SKILL.md. Proof: `! grep -niE 'model tiering|cheap.?tier|standard.?tier|strong.?tier' examples/agent-skills/rebar-implement/SKILL.md`
- [x] The held-out separation (a separate implementer subagent) is still stated in Phase 4.
      Proof: `grep -n 'separate' examples/agent-skills/rebar-implement/SKILL.md`
- [x] Phase 0 documents executing a childless story/task with a recorded file impact as a single
      code leaf, keyed on `rebar get-file-impact`. Proof:
      `grep -n 'get-file-impact' examples/agent-skills/rebar-implement/SKILL.md`
- [x] Frontmatter description, Phase 0 heading, Phase 2, and Reporting are consistent with both
      changes (checked: manual read of the four sections).

## Testing

Docs-only change to a Markdown skill file; no source code changes, so the CI `Verified` gate
(`make lint && make typecheck && make test`) is unaffected and passes unchanged. Verify the
acceptance criteria with the grep commands listed above, run from the worktree root.
